{{Quote|Rearguard actions across the board… Twenty-First was on Bestine.|Maximian Ajax, to Hazram Namir|audio=Twenty-First.flac|<ref name="TC" />}}
In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Twenty-First]] went on a '''mission''' to<ref name="TC" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Tarkin">[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']]</ref> [[Bestine IV]] as a part of a coordinated final effort to distract [[Imperial Military|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] and allow the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] to complete its [[Mid Rim Retreat|withdrawal]] from the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]]. News of the Twenty-First's efforts eventually reached the Alliance's [[61st Mobile Infantry]]. One of the [[company]]'s [[sergeant]]s, [[Maximian Ajax]], told the news to [[First Sergeant]] [[Hazram Namir]] during a conversation about the distraction effort.<ref name="TC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mission to Bestine IV was mentioned in the [[2015]] novel ''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]'', written by [[Alexander Freed]].<ref name="TC" />
